title: Afɔrebɔ a Wofi Pɛ mu Bɔ
intro: Wɔ ɔsoro sɔhwɛ bere mu no, wɔfrɛɛ ɔkra bi kɔɔ adeyɛ a etwa to a ɔde brɛ ne ho ase no mu. Wɔtetee saa onipa yi wɔ asase a ɛso yɛ kwa so no, onyinii bɛyɛɛ gyidi ne boasetɔ. Sɛ anisoadehu bi hyɛe sɛ wɔmfa afɔrebɔ mma a, wɔanhinhim. Wɔn asɛm no yɛ ahofama tweatibo.
clues: Na meyɛ odiyifo kɛse bi mpaebɔ a na wɔatwɛn akyɛ no ho mmuae.
Wogyaw me ne me maame wɔ bon bi a amamfõ wom mu a na date ne nsu nkutoo na ɛwɔ hɔ.
Minyinii bɛyɛɛ odiyifo a wonim no sɛ meyɛ nokware ne me boasetɔ.
Meboaa me papa ma ɔmaa ofie kronkron bi a wɔahyira so ama Allah no fapem so.
Bere a m’agya kaa dae bi kyerɛɛ me sɛ ɔde me bɛbɔ afɔre no, mibuae sɛ, ‘Yɛ sɛnea wɔahyɛ wo no.
Allah hyɛɛ me ahobrɛaseɛ anuonyam denam odwennini bi a ɔsomaa no firii soro sɛ ɔmmɛgye me no so.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Wofi wɔn pɛ mu brɛ wɔn ho ase sɛ wɔde wɔn bɛbɔ afɔre
Wɔtow no gu ogya a ɛredɛw mu
Mpataa kɛse bi a ɔbɛmene no
Ɔyare a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ
trial.answer: Wofi wɔn pɛ mu brɛ wɔn ho ase sɛ wɔde wɔn bɛbɔ afɔre

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔde odwennini kɛse bi gyee no
Wogyee no fii ogya no mu
Wogyee no fii nsuyiri no mu
Woyii no fii whale no mu
outcome.answer: Wɔde odwennini kɛse bi gyee no

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
